post.originalText:
GPT-6 Astra vs Claude Opus 5.5

Same prompt: "Build an interactive computer mouse made entirely of honey jelly."

Here’s what each result cost:
Claude Opus 5.5: $7.18
GPT-6 Astra: $3.88

Opus is making me want to eat a computer mouse

Which one wins this round? https://t.co/wYL7IWSOtj

sourceMaterials.text:
